create_account.title: Add account
create_account.description: Add an account. The key is set separately and never returned. The chat switch starts off and the chat label empty unless sent.

args.description: The agency that owns the accounts. The address decides, not the body.
The agency that owns the accounts. The address decides, not the body.
The agency that owns the accounts. The address decides, not the body.
The account.

update_account.title: Change account
update_account.description: Replace an account's settings and limits. The key is untouched. The chat switch and chat label are replaced only when sent.

args.description: The agency that owns the accounts. The address decides, not the body.
The account.

set_limits.title: Set limits
set_limits.description: Replace only the account's nine limits, tokens per test and scenarios at once among them (zero means none, null means the limit does not apply). Name, provider, address, model and key are untouched.

args.description: The agency that owns the accounts. The address decides, not the body.
The account.

set_default_account.title: Mark default
set_default_account.description: Mark the account as the agency's default. A second mark moves it: only one account of an agency is the default at a time. A test run spends from the default.

args.description: The agency that owns the accounts. The address decides, not the body.
The account to mark.

get_default_account.title: Read default
get_default_account.description: Read the agency's default account. With none marked it answers a refusal that says to mark one under Models.

args.description: The agency that owns the accounts. The address decides, not the body.

delete_account.title: Remove account
delete_account.description: Remove an account and its key.

args.description: The agency that owns the accounts. The address decides, not the body.
The account.

set_account_key.title: Set key
set_account_key.description: Replace the account's key. Written, never read back.

args.description: The agency that owns the accounts. The address decides, not the body.
The account.

test_account.title: Test account
test_account.description: Send one short request and store whether it worked, the message sent, the model's short reply (trimmed, at most 120 characters) and how many milliseconds the call took. Give key to test a key that is not saved yet: it is used for this one request, never stored, and the stored result is left alone. Leave it out to test the saved key. The key is never returned.

args.description: The agency that owns the accounts. The address decides, not the body.
The account.

chat_account.title: Chat with account
chat_account.description: Send a conversation to the account's model with its saved key and get back the model's next message. messages is the whole conversation so far, oldest first, each with a role (system, user, assistant or tool) and its content; an assistant message that asked for tools carries tool_calls (id, name, arguments as an object), and a tool message answers one of them with its tool_call_id. tools lists what the model may ask for (name, description, parameters as a JSON schema object). The reply is one assistant message: content, and tool_calls when the model wants a tool run; the caller runs it and sends the whole conversation again with the result. Nothing is stored except the account's usage, which counts against its limits. The key is never returned.

args.description: The agency that owns the accounts. The address decides, not the body.
The account.

record_usage.title: Record use
record_usage.description: Count one call's requests and tokens. A call made for a test run names the run and the step as test_run_id and step, and is also counted against the run.

args.description: The agency that owns the accounts. The address decides, not the body.

check_limits.title: Check limits
check_limits.description: Answer whether a call may go ahead, and the most tokens it may use. A call for a test run names it as test_run_id; once the run has used its tokens per test the answer is refused with budget_reached. The answer always carries the tokens per test and scenarios at once in force, zero when no limit applies.

args.description: The agency that owns the accounts. The address decides, not the body.

list_usage.title: List use
list_usage.description: Each limit of an account beside its count.

args.description: The agency that owns the accounts. The address decides, not the body.
The account.

list_test_run_usage.title: List a test run's use
list_test_run_usage.description: The tokens one test run used, step by step and in total.

args.description: The agency that owns the accounts. The address decides, not the body.
The test run.

set_ai_role_mapping.title: Map AI role
set_ai_role_mapping.description: Set the account an AI role calls the model through and the agency role it speaks for. The account must belong to the same agency. An empty id clears the mapping.

resolve_ai_role.description: The prompt, its parts by source (seat_description, objectives, values_rules, work_item_instructions, agency, fine_tuning), the account without its key, the limit in force for each of the five with whether the role or the account sets it, and the count so far. list_models.title: List models
list_models.description: The models for the Model dropdown: for each provider kind, the models this agency's last refresh found, then the standard starting list's models not already among them. Give provider to see one kind only.

args.description: The agency that owns the accounts. The address decides, not the body.
A provider kind to list. Leave out for every kind.

refresh_models.title: Refresh models
refresh_models.description: Ask the account's provider, with the account's key, which models the key can use, and replace this agency's list for that provider kind with the answer. An empty or failed answer leaves the list as it was. Answers the provider kind's list as ai_list_models shows it.

args.description: The agency that owns the accounts. The address decides, not the body.
The account whose key is used.
